name: relative-time
title: Relative Time
description: Render a date as a human-relative string ("2 hours ago", "yesterday") with native Intl.RelativeTimeFormat — self-updating, with an absolute-date tooltip.

meta.whenToUse: A timestamp relative to now — comment/activity times (ago) or calendar-day grouping (day).
meta.whenNotToUse: A fixed absolute date that should never change — just format it once.
